paradigms.title: hwā / hwæt NGDA
paradigms.scope: Singular only; one common masculine/feminine series and a neuter series. Productive ordinary subject, possessive, recipient/governed dative, direct-object accusative. No invented plural or separate feminine inflection.

paradigms.title: hwilc strong NGDA
paradigms.scope: Complete strong NGDA, ordinary interrogative modifier or predicate. No weak paradigm or dependent-question construction assigned.

paradigms.title: hwilc distinct instrumental reference
paradigms.scope: Recognition of the distinct masculine/neuter singular forms only; all instrumental constructions remain outside Unit8.

paradigms.title: hwæðer strong NGDA
paradigms.scope: Complete strong NGDA morphology; ordinary choice between two people, objects or explicitly plural groups. Plural morphology does not change the two-alternative meaning. Conjunction whether and indirect questions are unassigned.

paradigms.title: hwæðer distinct instrumental reference
paradigms.scope: Recognition of the distinct masculine/neuter singular forms only; all instrumental constructions remain outside Unit8.

paradigms.title: gehwilc strong NGDA
paradigms.scope: Complete strong NGDA morphology; ordinary attributive use. Extended partitives, negative concord, distributive correlations and free-choice clause syntax remain Unit15. Selected ordinary each/every use with a singular noun; complete plural morphology is available for analysis, not a license to replace every contextual eall.

paradigms.scope: Recognition of the distinct masculine/neuter singular forms only; all instrumental constructions remain outside Unit8.

paradigms.title: swilc strong NGDA
paradigms.scope: Complete strong NGDA morphology; ordinary attributive use. Extended partitives, negative concord, distributive correlations and free-choice clause syntax remain Unit15. Following ordinary attributive adjective remains strong in an indefinite phrase; distinct from already productive invariant swilce likewise.

paradigms.title: swilc distinct instrumental reference
paradigms.scope: Recognition of the distinct masculine/neuter singular forms only; all instrumental constructions remain outside Unit8.

paradigms.title: ilca weak NGDA
paradigms.scope: Complete singular/plural NGDA; weak-only ilca or selected emphatic self according to its separate use rule. Weak instrumental is syncretic with dative, with no general instrumental syntax assigned.

paradigms.title: self strong NGDA
paradigms.scope: Complete strong and weak NGDA. Agreement with the emphasized referent; nominative emphasis and accusative/dative reinforcement of a coreferential personal pronoun. Personal pronouns can be reflexive without self. No general modern English self-compounding rule.

paradigms.title: self distinct instrumental reference
paradigms.scope: Recognition of the distinct masculine/neuter singular forms only; all instrumental constructions remain outside Unit8.

paradigms.title: self weak NGDA
paradigms.scope: Complete singular/plural NGDA; weak-only ilca or selected emphatic self according to its separate use rule. Weak instrumental is syncretic with dative, with no general instrumental syntax assigned.

paradigms.title: ōðer strong NGDA, new other sense
paradigms.scope: New ordinary other/another sense; all24 existing strong NGDA forms retain their exact IDs/surfaces/ordinal analyses and prior teaching history. Forms remain strong even after article. No new ordinal milestone or indefinite reciprocal syntax.

paradigms.title: ōðer distinct instrumental reference
paradigms.scope: Earlier recognition scope only; no new general instrumental syntax.

paradigms.title: gehwā recognition reference
paradigms.scope: Recognition reference for the basic ge- compound of hwā: singular only, common masculine/feminine and neuter NGDA. Ordinary use, partitive combinations and independent production deferred to Unit15. No invented plural.

paradigms.title: se / sēo / ðæt relative NGDA
paradigms.scope: Ordinary inflected relative, alone or followed by ðe. Reuse all prior NGDA demonstrative cells; new relative sense/constructions only. Prefer case governed inside the relative in selected production; case attraction is a separately bounded recognition phenomenon.
